name: Arithmetic Edge-Weight Equivalence
description: Replaces the bilinear form $x^T A x = k$ with a custom arithmetic condition on the edges: $\sum 5^c = m + 4T$, where $c$ is the number of selected endpoints of an edge, and $T$ is the sum of degrees of the selected vertices. This requires multi-step algebraic simplification to deduce that the number of fully-selected edges must be 0, completely breaking matrix-based pattern matching.
